entry.name: plugsend~
entry.description: The use of the plugsend~ and plugreceive~ objects to pass audio between Max for Live devices is not supported. The plugsend~ and plugreceive~ objects are used to send audio signals from one pluggo plug-in to another. They are used in the implementation of the PluggoBus feature of many of the plug-ins included with pluggo.
